claim_restriction: This is a controlled within-example mediator-restoration assay. It supports necessity/sufficiency of the frozen terminal state for the targeted intervention effect only when paired with the already frozen natural free-generation endpoint; it is not a minimal circuit or a population natural-indirect-effect estimate.
